root_cause.text: The `adis_init` function in the IIO IMU ADIS driver dereferences the `adis->ops` pointer to access function members without first verifying that `adis->ops` is non-NULL, causing a crash when the structure is zero-initialized by `devm_iio_device_alloc()`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the condition from `if (!adis->ops->write ...)` to `if (!adis->ops) ... else if (!adis->ops->write ...)`, preventing the dereference of a NULL `adis->ops` pointer as confirmed by the CVE description stating `adis->ops` is NULL due to zero-initialization.
